original_test_intent: Verify a fully populated system survives 100 true cold power-off/on reboots at 40C and -5% 5V/3.3V rails with complete device recovery and no unexpected errors or hangs.
original_method: Freeze the complete serial/slot inventory; define cold reboot as an approved full-power state transition with true-off/discharge proof while preserving required BMC/OOB observation; use a rated fixture and explicit off/on dwell, auto-power behavior and readiness deadlines; execute 100 supervised cycles at controlled margin, recording each POST/OS/BMC transition, inventory and event delta; abort without retry on defined failure and restore nominal environment for final checks.
manual_activity: Operator controls the cold-power fixture and environmental margin, supervises 100 transitions and recovers the platform.
required_inputs: Definition of cold state, BMC state and true-off measurement
Fixture/feed rating, off/discharge/on dwell and auto-power policy
POST, BMC, OS and service readiness deadlines
Per-cycle event/device-loss policy, OOB abort and restoration
safety_requirements: Use interlocked power equipment rated for load and inrush
Maintain independent observation or console appropriate to the chosen cold state
Do not erase logs or silently retry
Abort on boot loop, missing device, severe RAS, electrical or thermal fault
agent_execution_scope: May analyze per-cycle state, inventory and log evidence
Must not actuate power, chamber or rails and must not assign DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve true-cold semantics, fixture timing and oracle

command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Full population, 40C, -5% 5V/3.3V and 100 cold reboots are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind each cycle to measured power-state transition, readiness timestamps, full inventory and log deltas.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds unambiguous cold-state semantics, true-off proof, rated fixture, deadlines and no-retry recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Warm reboot or AC cycling without the approved cold-state definition cannot replace this initialization path.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC may remain powered in some platform definitions of host cold reboot; acceptance depends on explicitly naming host, chassis, DC and AC states.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines whether BMC remains available, which rails must discharge, expected auto-power behavior and whether one failed cycle terminates the run.
expected_evidence: Approved cold-state/fixture definition and true-off measurements
Final nominal inventory, services and platform health

review_improvement: Prevents generic reboot automation from silently replacing true cold-start coverage and makes all 100 power-state recoveries auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: Cold restart behavior depends on which rails and controllers actually lose power. If the BMC or device auxiliary rails remain energized, the cycle may exercise a warm path. Measured state and per-cycle inventory are required to prove the intended negative-margin cold initialization.
